_comment: OPT-IN. Merge this ON TOP of template-settings.json only if you work with Kubernetes. It grants read-only kubectl verbs and registers block-kubectl-mutations.sh, which refuses the mutating ones. Registering that guard without these grants would be a guard for a tool the kit never mentions.

hooks.command:
bash -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude/hooks/block-kubectl-mutations.sh"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then exec bash "$h"; fi; printf "[agent-kit] hook not installed, skipping: %s
" "$h" >&2; exit 0'
